name: Temporary Residence Status -- Family Ties

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse, parent, or child of a citizen of the Republic of Armenia, or of a foreign national holding Armenian special residence status (or, per the general residence-permit summary, also permanent/temporary resident sponsors).
A document certifying the family connection, plus the sponsor's passport, special passport, permanent residence card, or temporary residence card.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or birth certificate proving family tie
Sponsor's Armenian passport, special passport, or residence card
Passport with Armenian translation, health reference, photos

sources.title: Migration and Citizenship Service (official e-government portal) -- temporary residence status document requirements for family ties: family-connection certificate plus sponsor's passport/special passport/residence card

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Armenia). No sponsor income or housing-adequacy threshold was found described on the tier-1 pages reviewed -- disclosed as a gap rather than invented. citizenship_after_months modeled 0 for this route specifically because a foreign spouse of an Armenian citizen can bypass the standard 3-year residence and language requirements entirely under Article 13's marriage exemption (see am_citizenship_by_marriage.json) rather than needing to wait out this residence permit's own general 3-year citizenship timeline -- this reflects the marriage case specifically; the parent/child grounds do not carry the same exemption and would follow am_naturalisation.json's general track instead.
